# Galerie de Ruiter

> Galerie de Ruiter is a gallery for antiques, art, vintage design and objects with a past, in
> Waasmunster, Belgium. It shows the collection on this site and answers questions about it in its
> own chat.

This file describes what the gallery publishes for agents. The pages below are written for people
and drawn by the application, so their source carries only the gallery's own summary: the address,
the opening hours and the collection live in the gallery's database, and the links are where the
current values are.

## Pages a visitor can read without an account

- [Home](https://galeriederuiter.cloud-ip.cc/): the landing page - what the gallery is, what it
  shows, and where it is.
- [About](https://galeriederuiter.cloud-ip.cc/about): the gallery's own story, with the address and
  the opening hours of the pop-up.
- [Map](https://galeriederuiter.cloud-ip.cc/map): the address, the opening hours, and a Google Maps
  frame of the place.
- [Chat](https://galeriederuiter.cloud-ip.cc/chat): the concierge, which answers questions about the
  collection and can take an appointment request for a visit.
- [Collection](https://galeriederuiter.cloud-ip.cc/antiques): the first list of pieces the gallery
  has, with photographs and prices. A visitor sees the first page of it and no more.

## Behind an account

- A piece's own page, the wishlist, the basket and the profile pages answer with the sign-in page
  until a visitor signs in, and so does everything past the first page of the collection list. The
  pieces are disallowed in `robots.txt`; the list itself is allowed and is in the sitemap.

## Buying

- The gallery does not sell online and takes no payment on this site. A purchase is arranged by
  contacting the gallery, and the chat on `/chat` is the way to start.

## For agents

- [Sitemap](https://galeriederuiter.cloud-ip.cc/sitemap_index.xml): the public pages, with the dates
  they changed.
- [AI catalog](https://galeriederuiter.cloud-ip.cc/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): what this domain
  offers agents, in the Agentic Resource Discovery format. It is the same document as
  [/.well-known/ard.json](https://galeriederuiter.cloud-ip.cc/.well-known/ard.json).
- [robots.txt](https://galeriederuiter.cloud-ip.cc/robots.txt): what may be crawled.
